summary_en: Nippon Steel's subsidiary Osaka Steel will conduct a public tender offer to acquire 2,800,000 of its own shares. Nippon Steel, which holds Osaka Steel shares, plans to tender all its holdings in response to the subsidiary's request. Following the sale, Nippon Steel's voting ratio in Osaka Steel is expected to fall to 51.0% (51.5% on a consolidated basis).
title_en: Notice Regarding Public Tender Offer for Treasury Shares by Our Subsidiary and Our Participation in the Tender Offer
translation_en_brief:
Osaka Steel, a consolidated subsidiary of Nippon Steel Corporation, has resolved to conduct a public tender offer to acquire 2,800,000 of its own ordinary shares. Nippon Steel, holding shares in Osaka Steel, intends to tender all of its holdings in response to a request from Osaka Steel to participate in the offer.

Following the sale of 2,800,000 shares by Nippon Steel, Nippon Steel's voting ratio in Osaka Steel is expected to be 51.0% on a standalone basis and 51.5% on a consolidated basis. Nippon Steel's decision to participate supports Osaka Steel's capital efficiency initiatives under its medium-term business plan aimed at enhancing enterprise value. The parent company views its participation as contributing to improvements in capital efficiency at the subsidiary and, by extension, to the enhancement of enterprise value across the Nippon Steel Group.

The impact on Nippon Steel's consolidated results from this transaction is described as immaterial.
